How It Works

Three Steps to Trade

No apps to download, no wallets to configure. Just start chatting.

1

Connect

Start a chat with @SuwappuBot on Telegram or WhatsApp. Your secure wallet is created instantly.

2

Swap

Send a simple command like "/s 100 USDC ETH" and get instant quotes from multiple DEX aggregators.

3

Confirm

Review the quote and tap confirm. Your swap executes instantly with real-time status updates.
